— OUR SERVICES

Everything your loved one
needs, under one roof.

Comprehensive care without the complexity — all services are included.

Private Rooms

Comfortable, furnished private rooms in a real home setting — not a ward or shared bay.

Specialized Care

Memory care, mental health support, and full medication and insulin management.

Home-Cooked Meals

Three nutritious meals daily prepared in-home. Dietary needs always accommodated.

Personal Care

Bathing, grooming, dressing, and hygiene assistance provided with dignity and respect.

Health Monitoring

Regular vital checks, coordination with physicians, and family health updates.

Activities & Engagement

Daily social activities, light exercises, and enrichment programs to keep minds active.

Cozy & SafeDesigned for daily dignity and warmth.
Life at 1st Blessed

A home designed for comfort, not efficiency.

We believe senior care should feel like living, not waiting. Our Everett home is designed around the rhythms of daily life — real meals, real rest, real connection.

Surrounded by natural beauty with easy access for family visits, our six-person model means every resident is known by name, not room number.

Why 1st Blessed

What makes us different from every other option.

Most senior care options offer scale. We offer the opposite — and that's exactly the point.

Talk to us today →
01

Small by design

Six residents maximum — always. This isn't about capacity, it's about what genuine care actually requires.

02

Real home, real neighborhood

A residential house in a real Everett neighborhood. Not a facility, not a wing — a home address.

03

Consistent caregivers

Your loved one is seen by the same faces every day. Continuity of care reduces anxiety and builds trust.

04

Family-first communication

Regular updates, open-door visits, and direct caregiver access. You are never kept in the dark.

05

State-licensed & inspected

Fully licensed by Washington State DSHS. We meet and exceed all AFH care standards.
